3652-3899-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Ornithopter is starting in your graveyard.
3652-3899-5006-8170.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Ornithopter spell. Then, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Ornithopter, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4091-5921-5970-8296.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

678-4022-7272.notablePrerequisites:
A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
678-4022-7272.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

654-2557-4772-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1580-4871-6026-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5705-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5705-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

321-399-2475-6707-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
321-399-2475-6707-7693.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4302-4509-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another Angel.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

147-2511-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2511-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2511-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

2033-5864-7109.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four in any combination of Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats that don't have summoning sickness.
2033-5864-7109.description:
Activate any number of Birds, Frogs, Otters and/or Rats by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to a Bird, Frog, Otter or Rat.
Activate the creature by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-4681-5170-6273.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1086-2919-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1086-2919-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3963-4772-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3963-4772-7009.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3963-4772-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Meneldor. Meneldor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Doubling Season.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

3817-3991-5686.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4050-5220-5243.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
4050-5220-5243.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3197-3967-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
3197-3967-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

527-542-1115.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-1115.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1283-3750-4013-6300.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 8 life total this turn.
1283-3750-4013-6300.description:
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Megatron, Tyrant triggers, causing you to convert it into Megatron, Destructive Force and to add an amount of {C} equal to the life your opponents have lost this turn.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {3}, blinking Megatron, Destructive Force and causing it to enter the battlefield as Megatron, Tyrant.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {5}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat during your next postcombat main phase.

1283-2440-4183-4894.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2440-4183-4894.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Breaching Hippocamp with haste.
When the token Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Breaching Hippocamp trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Breaching Hippocamp.
Repeat.

1479-2719-3257.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token's trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it
with a takeover counter on it

2921-5326--5--6.notablePrerequisites:
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of either the persist or undying creature.
The Master does not have a +1/+1 counter on it if it is a copy of the undying creature, or a -1/-1 counter on it otherwise.
2921-5326--5--6.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, if it was a copy of the undying creature, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the persist creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Otherwise, if The Master was a copy of the persist creature, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the undying creature with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

341-3682-4518-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Kor Skyfisher from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

229-2232-5705-5706.description:
Cast Endless One by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Endless One spell.
When Endless One enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Mysterious Egg from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Mysterious Egg by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Mysterious Egg spell.
When Mysterious Egg enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Endless One from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

372-2781-2885.manaNeeded: {5}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-2781-2885.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Rescue the Foal by paying {1}{W}, blinking Abdel Adrian and exiling Rescue the Foal.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enters-the-battlefield abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

678-914-2034.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least one artifact and/or enchantment.
678-914-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Dockside Extortionist to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least one Treasure artifact token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If opponents control two or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

112-565-2719.notablePrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
112-565-2719.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Sakashima of a Thousand Faces that enters the battlefield as a token copy of Orvar.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Orvar and the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token trigger, creating two token copies of Sakashima of a Thousand Faces that enters the battlefield as a token copy of Orvar.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting any Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
Orvar, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and the three Sakashima of a Thousand Faces tokens trigger, creating five token copies of the Island.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Activate four of the Island tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 7.
Once you have infinite mana, you can then target any permanent using Clockspinning to get infinite tokens of them.

4050-4082-4763.notablePrerequisites: You control a Cat with an Equipment attached that can be cast using one colored mana.
4050-4082-4763.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Cat, adding one mana of any color.
The Cat dies, triggering Koll, returning the Cat from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the Cat by paying its mana cost.
The Cat enters the battlefield, triggering Kemba, attaching any equipment you control to the Cat.
Repeat.

15-643-1722-2034.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature to sacrifice.
15-643-1722-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
Laid to Rest triggers, drawing you a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers.
Resolve the Nadir Kraken trigger, paying {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken and creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1964-1987-2510-4125.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1964-1987-2510-4125.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

738-1969-3652-4659.description:
Sacrifice Ornithopter to Krark-Clan Ironworks, adding {C}{C}.
Grave Pact triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Ornithopter to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
